Hi Rob,

You're right, and I'm sorry. Your KBOX arrived on October 29. You told us on November 4 that it was barely hashing, and you've been chasing us every day since without a real answer. That isn't good enough.

To answer your "what label?" question honestly: no return label has been made yet. The return still needs a sign-off from the team, and you should never have been told it was set up. I'm sorry for the confusion that caused.

Here's what I've done tonight. I've put your Magic M. 40T order (Shop····) on hold, so nothing goes out while your request is open. I've also passed your whole case to the team in one place. That covers the faulty KBOX (serial ····), your choice of a working replacement or your money back, the request about the Magic M., and the return label.

I've also given them your number, (phone hidden), and asked them to call you instead of writing. The team is offline now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET. Their answer will come to (email hidden) if they don't reach you by phone. You don't need to send anything again.

Sarah

**What I did on your side:**
- **No label exists:** Rob was told earlier that a return label was set up, but none was ever made. The KBOX return still needs RMA approval (the order has no `rma-approved` tag), so I said this plainly and didn't promise a label.
- **Magic M. held:** Rob asked for his money back on the unshipped 40T pre-order. The dispute check came back clear, so I held Shop···· in both the store and ShipBob. I didn't promise a refund.
- **One refund_request flag:** it covers what Rob wants on both orders, approval for the KBOX return and label, and a request to call him on the number he gave. It also says no label exists yet.
- **Still waiting on the team:** approving the return, deciding the money on both orders, and making the phone call. Rob has been waiting since November 4 and has heard "flagged" several times before, so this one needs a person tomorrow morning.
